name: Absorb Ability (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Ability drain

Benefit(s): You gain an inherent bonus, to the same ability score, equal to the amount drain from an ability score, up to a maximum of +6. If you drain Constitution and you do not possess a Constitution score, this bonus is added to Charisma instead.
